name: Steel Billet
description:
A small billet of plain carbon steel intended for tool edges and replacement fittings.

Sold by the pound. The listed price covers raw material only; shaping, fuel and labour are separate.

weight.notes: A measured one-pound sale unit; raw material mass is not discounted.
